info.name: JSONPlaceholder /posts
info.description:
API tests for the public JSONPlaceholder /posts resource.

IMPORTANT — fake persistence: JSONPlaceholder simulates writes. POST/PUT/DELETE return realistic responses (201 with a new id, echoed updates, empty delete body) but nothing is actually stored. Every assertion in this collection therefore targets *response behaviour* (status, headers, echoed payload, id rules) and never re-reads the API expecting a write to have persisted.

Run via Newman: `npm run test:api` (uses newman/jsonplaceholder.postman_environment.json), or import collection + environment into the Postman UI.
